nav-cta max-width transition is a one-time discrete toggle fired on a scroll-threshold crossing, not a continuous per-frame animation -- the layout-thrash concern this rule targets (scroll-linked/repeated reflow) doesn't apply here. Switching to transform/clip-path would either squish the button's text during reveal or leave a permanent dead-space gap in the nav's flex layout when hidden, both worse than the one-off reflow
